cohort: The study participants were women receiving antepartum prophylactic low-molecular weight heparin (LMWH) therapy undergoing a trial of vaginal delivery.
finding: Planned induction of labour was associated with a higher risk of postpartum thrombotic events compared to spontaneous onset of labour, though this difference was not statistically significant, and was also linked to prolonged duration of anticoagulation interruption.
mod_finding: Planned induction of labour was associated with a higher risk of postpartum thrombotic events compared to spontaneous onset of labour among women using prophylactic LMWH.
